title: Stalk constructibility of etale lower shriek of a finite constant module
statement: For qcqs schemes X and U, a finite commutative ring Lambda, an etale map j : U -> X and a finite Lambda-module M, the sheaf j_! constantSheaf(M) is constructible in the stalk-based IsConstructibleSheaf predicate.

proof.text: Choose the finite constructible stratification on which j becomes finite etale, identify lower shriek after pullback with lower shriek on the base change, replace finite-etale lower shriek by lower star, and use finite local constancy of finite-etale pushforward; these witnesses give the stalk-based constructibility predicate.

mathlib_searches.query: IsConstructibleSheaf finite locally constant etale lower shriek

lean.statement: theorem isConstructibleSheaf_etaleLowerShriek_constant_core {X U : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M] : IsConstructibleSheaf (FA := fun A B : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ => A →ₗ[Λ] B) (CA := fun A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ => A) ((Etale.etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j inferInstance).obj ((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
